newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's CPC shuts hydrocracking unit.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC shuts hydrocracking unit.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp said on Tuesday it has closed a hydrocracking unit in its Kaohsiung refinery because of minor gas leaks but added the unit would resume operation on Wednesday.
"Chinese Petroleum shuts its hydrocracking unit late on Monday due to safety concern, after workers found small gas leaks at the location," a company statement said.
The hydrocracking unit would be repaired on Tuesday and could resume its full operation on Wednesday, Kaohsiung refinery official Huang Yaw-hao said by telephone.
The non-poisonous gas leak was stopped after workers found the problem and quickly closed the unit, Huang said.
The statement said the leak was believe to have been caused by rain on Monday afternoon.
